entries.head:
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the December 5, 2007/Agrahayana 14, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Information and
Broadcasting; Labour and Employment; Parliamentary Affairs; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
90
Allegations on labour issues in
BALCO
*281. SHRI MOHAMMED AMIN:
SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Ministry of Mines has
forwarded allegations pertaining to labour
related issues in the Bharat Aluminium
Company Limited (BALCO) as stated in
the report titled "Impact of Privatisation
on Labour: A Study of BALCO
Disinvestment" by V.V. Giri National
Labour Institute for inquiry; and
(b) if so, whether the inquiry has been
completed?
Criteria for conferring 'Classical
Language' status
*282. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria for conferring 'Classical
Language' status on a language;
(b) the number of Indian languages
conferred the status so far and the languages
identified for the purpose;
(c) whether there is demand for
conferring the 'Classical Language' status
on Kannada and Tulu and inclusion of Tulu
and Kodava languages in the Eighth
Schedule of the Constitution; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard and
Centre's reaction thereto?
FTA with other countries
*283. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of countries with which
India has so far entered into Free Trade
Agreements (FTA) or similar agreements;
and
(b) the specific industries which have
been adversely affected by these
agreements?

91
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Separate labour laws for
SEZs
*284. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
intends to have separate labour laws for
Special Economic Zones (SEZs);
(b) if so, the details thereof and the kind
of changes contemplated in the existing
labour laws;
(c) whether Government has consulted
the various stakeholders in this regard;
(d) how labour disputes are currently
dealt with in the existing set up;
(e) whether Government has received
any representations in this regard; and
(f) if so, what kind of dispute settlement
mechanism has been desired by the workers
in the SEZs?
Industrial Corridor between Delhi
and Mumbai
†*285. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether scheme to build Industrial
Corridor between Delhi and Mumbai with
the partnership of India and Japan has been
finalized;
(b) if so, detailed outline thereof;
(c) the areas included in this Industrial
Corridor between Delhi and Mumbai;
and
(d) the schemes formulated by
Government for the development of these
areas?
Extension of NREGS
*286. SHRI DARA SINGH:
SHRI RAMDAS AGARW AL:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
extend the National Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme (NREGS) all over the
country;
(b) if so, whether ground work to extend
the scheme has been completed;
(c) the fund earmarked for the purpose;
(d) the number of additional families
likely to be covered under NREGS;
(e) whether any suggestion/request has
come from States in this regard; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
NREG programme in U.P.
*287. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
flagship scheme National Rural
Employment Guarantee (NREG)
programme has been accorded less priority
by the present Uttar Pradesh Government;
(b) whether Government is also aware
that there is no impact of this programme
in eastern Uttar Pradesh; and
(c) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Allocation of funds under rural
development schemes
†*288. SHRI SURENDRA LA TH: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:

92
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) the provision of funds made during
the last three years under various rural
development schemes by the Ministry and
the total amount allocated, out of that;
(b) funds utilized by the State
Governments out of the allocations made
to various States by the Ministry;
(c) whether the Ministry evaluates these
schemes from time to time for their proper
implementation;
(d) whether Government has received
any report of these schemes not being
implemented properly in some States;
and
(e) if so, the action taken by Government
thereon?

PMGSY
